1879052517.name: Press Onward
1879052517.desc: Quickly heals a great deal of Morale and grants a short movement buff when out of combat.

1879064293.name: Thrust
1879064293.desc: Deal a thrusting blow to open a Deep Wound.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires the use of Brutal Assault, Retaliate, or Whirling Retaliate.</rgb>

Critical hit with your parry response skills will restore 4% of your max power.
Critical hit with your parry response skills will restore 3% of your max power.
Critical hit with your parry response skills will restore 2% of your max power.

1879073381.name: Rain of Arrows: Fire-storm
1879073381.desc: Rains arrows down upon your enemies, allowing you to hit multiple targets.\n\nArrows inflict fire damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.

1879113829.name: Fleetness
1879113829.desc: You are able to greatly improve your mobility and your ability to fire on the move.

1879135205.name: Improved Merciful Shot
1879135205.desc: A massively damaging shot that unlocks when the target is below 50% health.\n\nCritical hits deal bonus damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Huntsman's Shot and Merciful Shot deal additional damage to bleeding targets.
Merciful Shot consumes the current tier of Lingering Wound on a target, dealing bonus damage.

1879198309.name: Friend of Sturdy Beasts (Wildpaw-bear)
1879198309.desc: Summons a bear companion.\n\nBears are tough companions which can draw the ire of the enemy.

1879228133.name: Shield and Fist
1879228133.desc: Capable Wardens prepare their shield and fist for attack.

1879232485.name: Nature Spirit (Spirit Boar)
1879232485.desc: Long live Bloodtusk! Though his hunting days are done, forever will his spirit prevail.

1879244261.name: Keen Strike
1879244261.desc: A keen edged blade and razor wit can combine to truly potent effect. Burglars can take advantage of the stratagem trick with this keen strike.\n\n<rgb=#ff6600>This skill is enhanced by Trick: Stratagem.</rgb>

procEffects.description: DNT - Grants the Burglar a crit response effect

1879254757.name: Invoke the Elements
1879254757.desc: Calling upon etchings representing the elements, the Rune-keeper composes a symbol with disastrous intent.

1879274085.name: Warning Shot - Fire
1879274085.desc: A powerful toss which aggravates your target, forcing them to attack you.

1879275749.name: Piercing Roar
1879275749.desc: Your enemies feel sharp pain as you sound the call of battle.

1879277925.name: Smouldering Wrath
1879277925.desc:
A channelled skill dealing huge amounts of fire damage every half second. This skill cannot be interrupted.

Duration increases per battle attunement.

This skill consumes 2 attunement per second.

Requires Battle Attunement.

1879302629.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Man-at-arms)
1879302629.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879315813.name: Rush
1879315813.desc: You erupt into a sprint, gaining ground quickly on your foes.

conditionalEffects.description: Using Rush in Bear Form causes your next attack to knock down your target:
Using Rush in bear form now applies to your fellowship.

1879344485.name: Happy Pig
1879344485.desc: A happy pig who would like to see the world with you.

1879358821.name: Golden Grain Kite
1879358821.desc: Brings out a golden grain kite for you to fly!

1879422309.name: Spotted Woodland Fawn
1879422309.desc: Summons a woodland deer to keep you company.

1879449573.name: Greater Anthem I - Compassion
1879449573.desc: Anthem: Reduces Incoming Damage and increases Frost and Lightning Resistance of all nearby fellowship or raid members.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 2 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>

1879491557.name: Sign of Power: See All Ends
1879491557.desc: Call upon your power of foresight, allowing you to avoid some incoming damage and masterfully using your staff to turn aside incoming blows.

1879494117.name: Guise of Tom Bombadil
1879494117.desc: A finely-crafted costume in the guise of Tom Bombadil. Never have you felt so compelled to hop along and speak in accentual verse! Hey dol! Merry dol! Ring a dong dillo!

1879497701.name: Minor Pet Command
1879497701.desc: Command your pet to execute a minor skill on themselves or their target.

1879508197.name: Shard of Reality
1879508197.desc: Use the Shard of Reality to lock your Madness to its current level for 60 seconds.

1879512933.name: Kingsfoil Knowledge
1879512933.desc: Knowledge from the Rangers of the North allows you to utilize Kingsfoil to heal minor wounds, but its true power lies in its ability to enhance the healing properties of other restoratives.

1879521253.name: Ruby Worm
1879521253.desc: Summons a fierce ruby worm to accompany you on your travels.
